## Error handling
- HTTP nodes: retry 3x with backoff, then the error branch fires ("Continue (using error output)").
- Error branch logs the failure and falls back to the cached Assignment 3 file — the digest still ships, flagged as cached.
- Code nodes: try/catch per record; malformed items go to quarantine, never crash the run.
- Missing fields default (company demand 0.5, empty text) and are noted in the run report.
See ERROR-HANDLING.md for the full table.
